A01.label: Index basis
A01.note: All money results scale linearly by actual NOI. Private rent is never guessed.

A02.label: Annual NOI growth, bear
A02.note: Anchors: county population -0.6% (S29), tenant SSS -1.1% (S04); below CPI.

A03.label: Annual NOI growth, base
A03.note: Anchors: between typical NNN escalators and metro CPI 3.7% (O06); explicitly an assumption.

A04.label: Annual NOI growth, bull
A04.note: Anchors: near metro ECI 3.9% (O07); requires successful renewal with strong escalators.

A05.label: Reinvestment / discount rate
A05.note: Anchored to the official 10-year Treasury print O01; held flat, no curve extrapolation.

A06.label: Exit cap-rate distribution (MC)
A06.note: Centered just inside the official net-lease benchmark yield 6.8% (O03). Distribution shape is an assumption.

A08.label: Rent growth distribution (MC)
A08.note: Mode = A03 (A02..A04 bear/base/bull); lower bound admits tenant SSS -1.1% (O11) and county population decline (S03/S29). An assumption, not a forecast.

A09.label: Earthquake annual hazard, hold path
A09.note: Derived ONLY from official 60% in 30 years (O08): p = 1-(1-0.60)^(1/30) = 3.03%/yr. Loss magnitude is separate (A10).

A10.label: Single-asset physical loss severity when a quake/fire hits
A10.note: ASSUMPTION — no official severity distribution for this parcel exists; parcel data withheld (F-11).

A11.label: Parcel wildfire annual hazard
A11.note: ASSUMPTION — no official parcel-level probability verified (F-11). Context: two major fires in one month, Jan 2025 (S14/S15).

A12.label: Tenant-default / non-renewal annual hazard
A12.note: ASSUMPTION informed by O11, O12 and FY26 guidance (S04); no official default probability exists.

A13.label: Tenant-default loss
A13.note: ASSUMPTION: re-tenanting a restaurant box at a wider cap with downtime.

A14.label: Systematic shock on diversified path
A14.value: Cap +1.5% for one year and 10% income loss
A14.note: ASSUMPTION: diversification removes idiosyncratic total loss but not market-wide shocks.

A15.label: City of Los Angeles transfer stack applies
A15.value: 4.45% (tier 1), modeled both with and without ULA
A15.note: Parcel location unresolved (F-08); county-only case omits ULA (county documentary transfer tax is not modeled and must be confirmed, F-08).

A16.label: Capital-gains tax in SELL case
A16.note: Basis and owner rates unknown (F-05, F-10); after-tax selling is strictly worse than shown, which is why EXCHANGE (deferral) is ranked above SELL.

A17.label: Holding costs net of NOI
A17.note: NNN structure: landlord outgoings limited to structural items; any special assessment is unknown (F-09).

A18.label: Diversified reinvestment total-return sensitivity
A18.note: Only 4.86% is anchored to an official print (O01). 6-9% are assumption rows showing what portfolio return would be needed to overturn the hold case; not a market forecast.
